newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Primac recommends no action on bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Primac recommends no action on bid.

text.p: Primac Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was recommending that shareholders take no action until further notice in regards to a takeover offer from IAMA Ltd.

IAMA is offering nine of its shares for every 10 shares held in Primac. Primac chairman Robin Hart said the Part A document had major deficiencies which would make it impossible for Primac shareholders to make a sensible investment decision.

"IAMA's Part A document does not include profit forecasts for the merged group and the last audited results are the year ended September 1995 which is more than 12 months ago," Hart said in a statement.
"The only figures included are unaudited forecast figures for 1996 and 1997 and these are based on assumptions which are very broad," he said.
Hart said shareholders should take no action at this stage and directors would keep them fully informed.
Primac shares closed steady at A$3.05, while IAMA ended one cent up at A$2.86.
Based on Wednesday's closing price, IAMA's offer values each Primac share at A$2.57 and the whole company at A$43.65 million.
